sources.title: Linux man-pages · System calls
sources.quote: The system call is the fundamental interface between an application and the Linux kernel.

sources.title: Microsoft · Processes and threads
sources.quote: A thread is the entity within a process that can be scheduled for execution.

sources.title: Microsoft · Scheduling
sources.quote: The system scheduler controls multitasking by determining which of the competing threads receives the next processor time slice.

sources.title: Microsoft · Virtual address space
sources.quote: The virtual address space for a process is the set of virtual memory addresses that it can use.

sources.title: Linux Kernel · Virtual File System
sources.quote: The file structure is placed into the file descriptor table for the process.

sources.title: Microsoft · Interrupt service routines
sources.quote: The system calls the ISR each time it receives that interrupt.

sources.title: Microsoft · Synchronization
sources.quote: There are a variety of ways to coordinate multiple threads of execution.

sources.title: Microsoft · Interprocess communications
sources.quote: The Windows operating system provides mechanisms for facilitating communications and data sharing between applications.
